scope: Complete selected source definitions extracted by AST into inert manually controlled fake capabilities; no whole candidate imports/CLI, no actual process/syscall/target/native/compiler/decoder
serial_queue: Only parent; fresh private workitems controls queue; never touch historical locks
required_review: Exact harness/guard/helper hashes, extraction safety and all fake dependencies; independent14case oracles plus retained predecessor negatives
raw_outputs: Unique exclusive mode.stdout/mode.stderr/mode.time; retain failures unchanged
policy_charge_rule: Each attempted controlled command debits max(1 second, ceiling(observed parent tool call wall milliseconds)/1000). This conservative policy debit is not a complete physical measurement.
measurements: Retain GNUtime elapsed/user/system/maxRSS/exit plus toolwall and all stdout/stderr. MaxRSS only covers timed test process, not a complete runtime family or original qualification.
